item.description: Volusia County Fire Rescue, in coordination with the Florida Forestry Service and the Daytona Beach Fire Department, is actively battling a brush fire exceeding 100 acres near Mosaic Boulevard off LPGA Boulevard in Daytona Beach. item.title: The Tiger matters!
item.description: Editor, The Beacon: I read the recently paid-for piece by Sidney Johnston and disagree with his reasoning and simplistic conclusion.
